poster_title: BELLE: A Bi-Level Multi-Agent Reasoning Framework for Multi-Hop Question Answering
authors: Taolin Zhang, Dongyang Li, Qizhou Chen, Chengyu Wang, Xiaofeng He

panels.headline: A novel bi-level multi-agent system (BELLE) for multi-hop QA
content: Addresses the challenges of multi-hop QA by dynamically combining appropriate operators.
Proposes a framework that includes a Question Type Classification module, a Bi-Level Multi-agent Debate module, and a Multi-hop QA Executor module.
Evaluates BELLE on four multi-hop QA datasets: MultiHop-RAG, 2WikiMultiHopQA, HotPotQA, and MuSiQue.
Uses GPT-3.5-turbo and Qwen2.5-7B as the underlying LLMs.
Demonstrates significant performance improvements and cost-effectiveness in complex multi-hop QA tasks.

panels.headline: Multi-hop QA involves step-by-step reasoning to answer complex questions
content: LLMs often struggle with complex multi-hop questions, leading to factual errors or hallucinations.
Existing approaches have limitations: closed-book reasoning lacks external knowledge, while retrieval-augmented reasoning incurs additional computational overhead.
BELLE aims to dynamically combine appropriate operators based on question types to improve performance and efficiency.
Evaluates BELLE on four multi-hop QA datasets to demonstrate its effectiveness.
Provides an in-depth analysis of the sensitivity of different question types to various methods.

panels.headline: Bi-Level Multi-Agent Debate module involves slow and fast debaters
content: Proposes a BELLE framework with a Question Type Classification module, a Bi-Level Multi-agent Debate module, and a Multi-hop QA Executor module.
The Bi-Level Multi-agent Debate module monitors viewpoint changes and determines the appropriate operators.
panels.figure_caption: Model overview of BELLE. The left part is the existing MAD system containing three basic roles (i.e., an affirmative side, a negative side and a judge). The right part is the details of our bi-level MAD system including first-level and second-level debaters.

panels.headline: Evaluates BELLE on four multi-hop QA datasets
content: Evaluates BELLE on MultiHop-RAG, 2WikiMultiHopQA, HotPotQA, and MuSiQue.
Uses GPT-3.5-turbo and Qwen2.5-7B as the underlying LLMs.
panels.figure_caption: Ablation study of BELLE in terms of F1 (%). Due to space limitation, we use the abbreviations 'D1', 'D2', 'D3', and 'D4' to represent Multi-hop RAG, HotpotQA, 2WikiQA, and MuSiQue, respectively.

panels.headline: BELLE outperformed strong baselines with an average performance improvement of 3%
content: BELLE significantly outperformed strong baselines in various datasets.
The computational cost of BELLE was more cost-effective than that of single models in more complex multi-hop QA scenarios.
panels.figure_caption: Comparison of single and combined operators in different multi-hop question types. The red and purple bars represent the combined operators of sub-step + single-step and sub-step + iterative-step, respectively.

panels.headline: Combined operators outperformed single operators across all four question types
content: The system relies on accurate question type classification, which may introduce errors.
The multi-agent debate process can be computationally intensive, although it is more cost-effective overall.
The performance of BELLE is sensitive to the number of retrieval tokens used.
Different LLMs show varying performance in multi-hop QA tasks.
More debaters in the first and second layers generally improve performance.

panels.headline: BELLE effectively addresses the challenges of multi-hop QA
content: BELLE shows significant performance improvements and cost-effectiveness in complex multi-hop QA tasks.
Future work can explore more fine-grained question type classification and further optimization of the multi-agent debate process.
The framework can be extended to other NLP tasks requiring multi-step reasoning.
The bi-level MAD system can be adapted to different types of multi-hop questions.
The results highlight the importance of dynamic operator combination in multi-hop QA.
